kohs_core.screen.title: KoHs Core
kohs_core.tab.performance.description: Live frame rate and heap usage, plus the settings that decide how hard Core leans on everything else when the game starts to struggle.
kohs_core.tab.graphics.description: Vanilla's quality settings, plus two tiers below anything vanilla offers. Everything here is written through the game's own options, so Sodium and Iris keep working normally.
kohs_core.tab.particles.description: Every particle type the game knows about, searchable, each with a live preview. Switch off the ones you never want to see, or cap how many can spawn per second.
kohs_core.tab.entities.description: Control draw distance for entities, drops and allocation-heavy world text. Players are never hidden by Core.
kohs_core.tab.input.description: Raw mouse input, scroll handling and frame pacing. The two things that actually shorten the gap between a click and the screen are raw input and a frame cap just below your refresh rate.
kohs_core.tab.memory.description: Allocation prevention and heap-pressure limits. Core never forces System.gc during play; it avoids creating disposable work when the heap or frame time is already under pressure.
kohs_core.tab.jvm.description: Your actual hardware, and the launch arguments that suit it. Heap size and collector are fixed when Java starts, so these are arguments to paste into your launcher.
kohs_core.tab.integration.description: Which mod is currently driving each setting. Anything another mod has taken over is greyed out here rather than fought over.
kohs_core.locked.description: %s is driving this setting. Core has stepped aside rather than write the same value twice a frame. Change it in that mod instead.
kohs_core.description.idle: Hover over anything to read what it does.
kohs_core.option.adaptive_budget.descrip: Shrink the particle allowance on its own when frames get expensive, so a busy fight thins out instead of turning into a slideshow.
kohs_core.option.unfocused_fps.descripti: Frame cap applied when the window loses focus. Useful when you alt-tab often and would rather the GPU went quiet.
kohs_core.option.pause_minimised.descrip: Stop rendering entirely while the window is minimised, rather than drawing frames nobody can see.
kohs_core.option.gui_particles.descripti: The purple field drifting behind this screen. It is drawn with plain rectangles and costs very little, but it can be switched off.
kohs_core.option.gui_density.description: How many particles the menu field holds. Scales with window size and stops at a ceiling, so fullscreen never becomes expensive.
kohs_core.option.typewriter.description: Reveal this panel one character at a time instead of all at once.
kohs_core.option.typewriter_speed.descri: Milliseconds per character. At the 0.1 ms floor the whole sentence lands within a single frame; around 6 ms is the fastest speed where the effect is still visible.
kohs_core.option.inactivity_fps.descript: Vanilla's safe background throttle: either only while minimised, or also after the player has been inactive.
kohs_core.option.chunk_priority.descript: Which chunk rebuilds vanilla finishes first. Prioritising nearby work can look smoother; no priority has the lowest scheduling overhead.
kohs_core.option.chunk_fade.description: How long newly compiled chunk sections fade in. Zero removes the transition work and shows them immediately.
kohs_core.option.autosave_indicator.desc: Show the small autosave indicator. This has negligible cost and is kept here so every vanilla video preference remains available.
kohs_core.option.menu_blur.description: Strength of the vanilla background blur behind menus. Lower values reduce the off-screen blur work.
kohs_core.option.quality_tier.descriptio: Three tiers below normal play. Pixelated uses nearest filtering with no mipmaps and a short view; Potato cuts view distance to two chunks. Selective far-only LOD is not claimed because vanilla has no safe hook for it.
kohs_core.option.sharp_radius.descriptio: The near area retained by the Pixelated approximation. Core draws two additional chunks, but uses the low texture settings globally because vanilla cannot pixelate only distant sections without replacing the renderer.
kohs_core.option.vanilla_preset.descript: Every vanilla graphics preset, including Custom. This writes several options at once and is disabled if another renderer owns any of them.
kohs_core.option.render_distance.descrip: How many chunks are drawn. The single biggest lever on frame rate there is.
kohs_core.option.simulation_distance.des: How far the world keeps ticking. Affects the server side of a singleplayer world more than the frame rate.
kohs_core.option.clouds.description: Clouds are drawn every frame whether or not you are looking up. Off is free frames on a weak GPU.
kohs_core.option.cloud_range.description: How far clouds are rendered. Lowering this reduces cloud geometry without shortening terrain view distance.
kohs_core.option.weather_radius.descript: Radius used for rain and snow around the camera. A smaller radius reduces weather particles and draw work.
kohs_core.option.biome_blend.description: How far grass and water colours are smoothed across biome edges. Zero is noticeably cheaper and only visible at the seams.
kohs_core.option.mipmap.description: Lower levels use less texture memory. Zero creates the intentionally crisp, pixelated look but can shimmer while moving.
kohs_core.option.texture_filtering.descr: Nearest, RGSS or anisotropic texture sampling. Nearest is cheapest; anisotropic is clearest at steep angles.
kohs_core.option.anisotropy.description: Anisotropic sample count when that filter is selected. Higher values sharpen angled textures at extra GPU cost.
kohs_core.option.cutout_leaves.descripti: Draw transparent gaps in leaf blocks. Turning it off uses simpler opaque leaf geometry.
kohs_core.option.transparency.descriptio: Vanilla's improved translucent sorting. It can look better but rebuilds and draws more complex geometry.
kohs_core.option.entity_shadows.descript: The soft blob under every mob. Cheap individually, not cheap with forty mobs on screen.
kohs_core.option.ambient_occlusion.descr: Soft shading in corners. Costs mesh build time rather than frame time, so it shows up as stutter when chunks load.
kohs_core.option.vignette.description: Darkening around the screen edges. Purely cosmetic.
kohs_core.option.view_bobbing.descriptio: Camera sway while walking. Off is steadier to aim with and slightly cheaper.
kohs_core.option.gamma.description: Vanilla brightness. It changes presentation only and does not alter light levels known by the server.
kohs_core.option.fullscreen.description: Use fullscreen mode. The same vanilla option and callback are used here.
kohs_core.option.exclusive_fullscreen.de: Request exclusive fullscreen rather than borderless presentation. Minecraft may require a restart for this change.
kohs_core.option.gui_scale.description: Vanilla GUI scale. Core recomputes every panel from the new logical size and remains usable through scale 4x.
kohs_core.option.attack_indicator.descri: Where vanilla draws the attack cooldown indicator. Herzium owns this control when installed.
kohs_core.option.fullscreen_resolution.d: Preferred exclusive-fullscreen resolution and refresh rate. Applied through vanilla when this screen closes.
kohs_core.option.particles_off.descripti: A master switch for particles owned by Core. Exact effects reserved by a priority KoHs mod remain untouched and their rows show who owns them.
kohs_core.option.vanilla_particles.descr: Vanilla's All, Decreased and Minimal density setting. Core's per-type and pressure filters run after this preference.
kohs_core.option.particle_budget.descrip: How many particles may spawn per second across every mod that asks Core. Shared, so several mods firing at once degrade together instead of each staying inside its own private limit.
kohs_core.option.particle_distance.descr: Particles further than this from the camera are dropped as they spawn, before anything is allocated for them.
kohs_core.option.entity_culling.descript: Skip drawing entities past the distance below. Off by default, and free when off.
kohs_core.option.entity_distance.descrip: How far entities are still drawn. Your own player is never culled.
kohs_core.option.cull_shadows.descriptio: Drop entity shadows before dropping the entities themselves, which keeps mobs visible for longer.
kohs_core.option.entity_scaling.descript: Vanilla's own entity distance multiplier. Lower means mobs stop being drawn sooner.
kohs_core.option.raw_input.description: Take mouse movement straight from the device instead of through the desktop's pointer, which removes acceleration and one layer of buffering.
kohs_core.option.smooth_scroll.descripti: Stop quantising the scroll wheel into whole notches. Noticeable on high-resolution wheels, invisible on ordinary ones.
kohs_core.option.mouse_sensitivity.descr: Vanilla mouse sensitivity with exact one-percent steps. Core never synthesises movement or changes rotations after this vanilla mapping.
kohs_core.option.wheel_sensitivity.descr: Vanilla high-resolution wheel multiplier. It changes local scrolling only and does not create extra game actions.
kohs_core.option.protect_input.descripti: Never run memory work on a frame that is handling a click or a keypress. This is what stops the memory features from costing you latency.
kohs_core.option.vsync.description: VSync removes tearing by making the GPU wait for the display. That wait is added latency; off plus a frame cap is usually the better trade for aiming.
kohs_core.option.framerate.description: A cap slightly below your refresh rate keeps the GPU from queueing frames ahead, which is where most felt input delay comes from.
kohs_core.option.memory_enabled.descript: Reduce new transient allocations under sustained heap or frame pressure. Core never calls System.gc during play, so this mode cannot create a forced stop-the-world pause.
kohs_core.option.adaptive_memory.descrip: Let the shared particle ceiling fall only after sustained pressure and recover slowly, preventing rapid visual flicker.
kohs_core.option.memory_particle_ceiling: Normal particle ceiling. Unlimited stays unlimited while healthy, then receives a conservative emergency ceiling under heap pressure.
kohs_core.option.trim_screen.description: Do memory work when a menu opens or closes, where a pause is hidden by the transition anyway.
kohs_core.option.trim_idle.description: Also do it once you have been standing still for a while.
kohs_core.option.idle_delay.description: How long you must stand still before an idle compaction is allowed.
kohs_core.option.heap_threshold.descript: Heap occupancy at which Core starts preventing additional transient work. This does not request a collection or pause the render thread.
kohs_core.particles.hover:
%s  ·  %s
The preview is a stylised likeness built from the particle's motion and colour, not the live simulation. Click the row to toggle this type.
kohs_core.jvm.disclaimer: Core cannot apply any of this. Heap size and garbage collector are fixed when Java starts, so no mod can change them from inside a running game. Paste the line you want into your launcher's JVM arguments and restart.
kohs_core.jvm.copy.description: Copy the %s profile's arguments to the clipboard, ready to paste into your launcher's JVM arguments field.
kohs_core.integration.explain: Core assumes ownership from the mods it finds installed. A mod that registers a kohs:core entrypoint can claim a domain explicitly, and an explicit claim always replaces the assumption.
kohs_core.button.vanilla.tooltip: Open Minecraft's own Video Settings screen, for anything Core does not surface here.
kohs_core.yield.inventory_tweaks_cursor: KoHs Inventory Tweaks owns the cursor and raw input path.
kohs_core.yield.anchors_particles: KoHs Anchors runs its own budget for explosion particles.
kohs_core.yield.death_effects_particles: KoHs Death Effects spawns its own effect particles.
kohs_core.yield.death_effects_screen: KoHs Death Effects draws its own screen-space effects.
kohs_core.yield.herzium_screen: Herzium draws its own HUD and screen effects.
kohs_core.yield.synapse_input: KoHs Synapse owns the mouse and keyboard path and drives the camera from its own raw report queue.
kohs_core.yield.sodium_graphics: Sodium replaces the renderer and owns these settings.
kohs_core.yield.sodium_distance: Sodium manages chunk loading and view distance.
kohs_core.yield.sodium_extra: Sodium Extra already gates this per type.
kohs_core.yield.iris: Iris is driving the shader pipeline.
kohs_core.yield.nvidium: Nvidium manages chunk rendering and distance.
kohs_core.yield.entityculling: Entity Culling does this with proper occlusion tests.
kohs_core.yield.moreculling: More Culling handles part of this.
kohs_core.yield.dynamic_fps: Dynamic FPS owns frame pacing while unfocused.
kohs_core.yield.particle_core: Particle Core gates particles per type.
kohs_core.yield.raw_input: Raw Input Buffer owns the mouse input path.
kohs_core.yield.ixeris: Ixeris owns the input threading model.
kohs_core.yield.ferritecore: FerriteCore already reduces memory use structurally.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.kohs_core: Optimisation layer and coordination bus for the KoHs mod family.
kohs_core.option.perf_hud.description: A small readout in the corner while you play. F3 already shows a frame rate, but it also covers a third of the screen with things you do not need mid-fight.
kohs_core.option.perf_hud_corner.descrip: Which corner the overlay sits in. It hides itself whenever the F3 screen is open, so the two never stack.
kohs_core.option.perf_hud_detail.descrip: How much it shows. The worst-frame figure is the one that matters for stutter: 120 average with one 40 ms frame per second feels worse than a steady 90, and an average alone cannot tell them apart.
kohs_core.option.item_distance.descripti: A separate distance for dropped items and experience orbs. These are what actually pile up, and none of them carry information worth a draw call at range, unlike a player at forty blocks.
kohs_core.option.text_distance.descripti: Stops drawing only the text on distant signs and text displays. Their backing sign or entity remains present. This cuts the allocation-heavy text path common in busy server hubs; Vanilla disables this limit.
kohs_core.option.block_entity_distance.d: Chests, signs, banners, skulls, beacons and shulkers past this distance build no render state at all. Broader than the sign-text limit above, which keeps the sign and drops only its lettering. A hub is mostly block entities, so this is usually the single largest frame saving available here. It is drawing work only: no block, interaction or packet changes. 0 is vanilla.
kohs_core.option.block_entity_adaptive.d: Lets the pressure monitor pull the distance above in while frames are expensive, and hand it back when they are not. It only ever tightens, so turning this on cannot add work, and it never goes below sixteen blocks: a hub where the chest in front of you vanishes is not a faster hub.
kohs_core.particles.ambient_off.tooltip: Switches off the decorative types only: smoke, drips, spores, falling leaves and the like. Explosions, crits and effect clouds are left alone, because hiding those changes what you can see happening to you.
kohs_core.tab.animations.description: Stop the visual motion that costs work but adds no information: animated textures, hand sway, entity bobbing, block animations and clouds. Every branch can be enabled independently.
kohs_core.tab.streaming.description: A quiet mode for capture and streaming. Streaming integrations may claim this domain; when they do, Core steps aside automatically.
kohs_core.tab.suite.description: One place for the KoHs family. Installed mods appear with their version, a short description and a gear when they expose a configuration screen.
kohs_core.animation.master.description: Master switch for the visual animation governor. It never changes server logic, redstone timing or hit detection.
kohs_core.animation.textures.description: Pause animated atlas sprites such as fire, water and portals. The first upload is preserved so this does not cause a texture re-upload hitch.
kohs_core.animation.fire.description: Pause animated fire and soul-fire textures.
kohs_core.animation.water.description: Pause flowing water and water overlay textures.
kohs_core.animation.portal.description: Pause portal, end-portal and other swirling portal textures.
kohs_core.animation.vegetation.descripti: Pause animated leaves, vines, kelp and other plant textures.
kohs_core.animation.redstone.description: Pause animated redstone, beacon and powered-device textures.
kohs_core.animation.other_textures.descr: Pause animated textures from resource packs and mods that Core can safely identify.
kohs_core.animation.interval.description: Minimum ticks between animated texture frames. A higher value reduces upload work while keeping the texture moving.
kohs_core.animation.entities.description: Freeze non-player entity bobbing and walk animation state. Players remain readable and responsive.
kohs_core.animation.items.description: Remove the dropped-item spin and bob while keeping the item visible.
kohs_core.animation.blocks.description: Freeze animated block entities such as chests, bells, conduits, banners and enchantment tables.
kohs_core.animation.clouds.description: Pin the cloud layer to the camera instead of rebuilding its position every frame.
kohs_core.animation.hands.description: Remove swing, eat and brush transforms from the first-person hand. Item use still completes normally.
kohs_core.animation.preview.description: A tiny atlas preview showing how the fire, water and vegetation branches respond to the switches above.
kohs_core.streaming.info: Streaming cadence is adaptive and input-safe. A compatible capture mod can claim this domain and expose its own controls here.
kohs_core.suite.description.crystal_twea: Crystal placement and combat quality-of-life tweaks.
kohs_core.suite.description.herzium: HUD, screen effects and client presentation tools.
kohs_core.yield.animation_owner: Another mod owns this animation domain. Core leaves its controls unchanged.
kohs_core.option.lightmap_throttle.descr: Vanilla rebuilds the lightmap twenty times a second because the torch flicker always moves, even standing still underground with nothing changing. This skips the rebuild when nothing that alters the result has changed. Costs a little torch shimmer; saves the environment lookups.
kohs_core.option.background_cpu.descript: WARNING: this is the one setting here that trades latency. It makes the client sleep 500 microseconds instead of 100 between idle checks, which frees CPU for a capture or encoder. It only applies while the window is NOT focused, so playing is untouched, but the moment you alt-tab back the first task can be up to half a millisecond late.
kohs_core.option.skip_empty_passes.descr: Return early from toast and debug-gizmo passes when there is nothing in them. Vanilla already guards most of this; what is left is the debug pass, which builds a value accessor before checking whether any renderer wants it.
kohs_core.option.nametag_distance.descri: Stop drawing entity nametags past this distance. Each one is a separate text draw with its own background quad, so a crowded area pays for them repeatedly. Vanilla's own limit is used when this is off.
kohs_core.option.hide_player_nametags.de: Off by default on purpose: hiding player names changes what you can see about who is around you, which is a decision for you rather than a default.
kohs_core.option.particle_state_cache.de: Reuse a particle's light lookup while it stays in the same block within the same tick. The result is identical; the lookup just is not repeated for every particle in a cloud sitting in one block.
